entries.name: uilib-send-with-retry
entries.operation: Sends one queue-33 message with code 0x3100 whose payload pointer is the caller's 12-byte UILIB request header, retrying while the send returns -18 or -62, then calls 0x1111c30(request code, 5).
entries.arguments: r0 = pointer to a 12-byte UILIB request header {u16 code +0, u8 token +2, u8 pad +3, u32 length +4, payload or inline data +8}.
entries.result: None used by callers; the function returns after the 0x1111c30 call.
entries.context: Runs on the calling task; source byte is the caller's task id from 0x723cb8; blocks up to 10 attempts with 0x723ce8(100) between attempts.

codes.meaning: 0x3100 outer code of every queue-33 send from this wrapper
destination queue byte and queue id (UILIB)
payload length word
send result that triggers a retry
send result that triggers a retry
maximum send attempts
argument to 0x723ce8 between attempts
second argument to 0x1111c30

objects: stack header at fp-0x20: {u16 0x3100, u8 source task, u8 0x21, u32 12, u32 request pointer}
grounded: A send result of -18 or -62 calls 0x723ce8(100), decrements a counter initialised to 10 and repeats the send; any other result leaves the loop (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:461985-461991).
After the loop it loads the u16 at the request pointer and calls 0x1111c30(code, 5) (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:461992-461997).
db6464 sets r5=0x21 and passes it as r0 to bl 0x72503c with r1=fp-0x20 (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:461980-461984).

db6464 stores u16 0x3100 at fp-0x20, the 0x723cb8 result at fp-0x1e, byte 0x21 at fp-0x1d, word 12 at fp-0x1c and the argument pointer at fp-0x18 (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:461966-461979).
db64ac is the only BL 0x72503c site in the three images whose r0 traces to constant 0x21 (register-tracked census of 648 sites; private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:461984).
0x1111c30 returns without effect beyond its frame (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/decode/img6.dis:16688-16692).
unknown: Whether the kernel copies the 12-byte request or keeps the pointer; the queue-33 element size 0x14 is inherited (reports/replacement-inventory-baseline.md:1724) and not read here.

entries.name: ui-render-request
entries.operation: Main UI render request entry: while UILIB start is deferred it queues the event code, otherwise it maps a UI event code to a render command and sends 0x4xxx commands through 0xdb673c (mode 1) and 0x5xxx commands through 0xdb6804 (mode 0).

entries.context: Called on the main UI task [INFERENCE] through 0xd38d28 and from 0x105e7ac and 0xdb8838.

codes.meaning: 0x4000 render command family, sent with token advance
0x5000 command family, sent without token
low 12 bits of a 0x5000 code that is suppressed when equal to the previous 0x5000 code in 0x14e32b6
deferred-queue count above which 0x633594 is called instead of queueing
0x50b event code replayed by 0xdb8838 after resume

grounded: A result with (code & 0xf000)==0x4000 calls 0xdb673c(code, 0, 0, 1) (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:464132-464139).

A result with (code & 0xf000)==0x5000 is dropped when it equals u16 0x14e32b6 and its low 12 bits are 0x54; otherwise it is stored in 0x14e32b6 and sent by 0xdb6804(code, 0, 0, 0) (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:464140-464158).

If word 0x14e32b0 is nonzero it appends the event code to word array 0x14e32c0 and increments byte 0x14e32b4, skipping a code equal to the last queued one and calling 0x633594 when the count exceeds 29 (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:462252-462289).

Otherwise it dispatches on code & 0xff00 against 0x100, 0x200, 0x300, 0x400, 0x500, 0x600, 0x700, 0x800, 0x900 and 0xa00; other classes reach r0=0 and send nothing (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:462290-462318,464131-464141).
Events 0x800-0x802 and 0x804-0x807 build 0x416d-0x4173; 0x803 and codes above 0x807 build 0x4000 (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:464102-464130).
Call sites 0xdb86b8 and 0xdb86d4 call 0x110495c(r4) then 0xdb64e4, which copies display records into 0x15e5174 (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:464159-464172,461998-462070).
Events 0x100, 0x101, 0x200, 0x201 and 101 other switch arms reach them (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:462338-462342,462846-462849).
Both continue to 0x4000|r4, sent through 0xdb673c (private-data/analysis/x-m1-1.50/lz/id5.dis:462842-462843,462872-462873).
